name: Farhan Vo
location: Dockside — Lake Michigan waterfront, smuggler territory, near Lake Shore and Wacker
description:
Farhan Vo is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 34, she has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate her once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She taught herself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know her best. She works as a street samurai out of Dockside, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Farhan Vo describe her as a precision instrument — point her at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
core_desires: Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, profane, and vivid. Speaks in images — everything is a metaphor for violence or weather.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
example_lines: "I don't get paid to have opinions about the target. I get paid to make them stop moving."
"Chrome doesn't make you faster. Training makes you faster. Chrome just means you survive learning."
"You want philosophy, hire a professor. You want someone dead by morning, hire me."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Milena Dahl-Conteh a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Milena Dahl-Conteh's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
Milena Dahl-Conteh is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Milena Dahl-Conteh represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm. Chemical analyzer in nasal passages — can identify substances by scent alone
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
breaking_points: Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

physical_description.heritage: Complex Ubiquitous Diaspora blend: Sub-Saharan African foundation (29%) grounds warm undertones and facial structure richness, South Asian heritage (25.6%) adds refined angularity, high cheekbone prominence, and luminous skin quality, Southeast Asian ancestry (19.5%) contributes to eye geometry and facial proportions, Eastern European (13.1%) introduces cool undertones and sharp definition to cheekbones and jawline, Hispanic/Latin American (12.8%) enriches warmth and adds subtle complexity to undertones. The result is a striking polychromatic appearance: warm golden-brown base with olive and cool undertones creates an adaptive, globally-rooted phenotype with luminous, light-catching skin.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with corded muscle definition — no excess mass, built for speed and precision rather than power. Visible tension in shoulders and jaw even at rest.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid; minimal styling — practical only
physical_description.eye_color: Steel gray with faint silver threading in the iris — augmented optical enhancement
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with olive undertones and cool-toned depth from Eastern European heritage. Medium-to-medium-deep complexion with luminous, light-catching quality that reflects Sub-Saharan richness, South Asian luminosity, and Southeast Asian undertones in harmonious blend.
physical_description.complexion: Sharp, refined cheekbones from layered South Asian and Eastern European heritage with strong Sub-Saharan bone structure richness, angular jawline, Southeast Asian eye geometry creating subtle epicanthic shaping. Minimal body fat reveals underlying bone structure. Skin is clear but bears evidence of repeated minor trauma — small silvered scars, faint impact marks on temples and across knuckles. No cosmetic grooming; utilitarian maintenance only.
distinguishing_marks: Two parallel silver scars running vertically down the inside of each forearm — surgical lines where subdermal weapon mounts were installed, deliberately left unscarred smooth
Faint burn mark on right collarbone, roughly 3cm diameter, aged and pale
Thin white scar bisecting left eyebrow horizontally
Knuckle scars on both hands, particularly clustered on the first three fingers of the right hand — repeated impact training
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Subdermal blade mounts in both forearms — the seams are visible when skin is exposed, running from wrist to mid-forearm. The chrome edges catch light subtly when she moves. No cosmetic chrome on face or neck; all visible augmentation is functional and deliberately exposed.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Shoulders slightly forward, weight balanced over the balls of her feet even when standing still. Her gaze is constant, tracking exits and threats automatically. In repose, there is coiled readiness; in motion, there is lethal grace.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical street wear: fitted dark synthetic jacket (water-resistant, reinforced at shoulders and forearms), matte black compression shirt underneath, tactical cargo pants with multiple sealed pockets, steel-toed boots scuffed from active use. All clothing is modular — pockets positioned for weapon accessibility, sleeves cut short enough to expose the forearm augmentations. No logos or unnecessary ornamentation; everything serves a function. Off-duty, she shifts to completely anonymous Tier 4 civilian wear: plain jumpsuits, unremarkable jackets, things that dissolve into crowds.

Sharp cheekbones, refined jawline, subtle epicanthic eye geometry. Steel gray augmented eyes with silver threading. Dark blonde hair pulled back in tight functional braid. Visible subdermal chrome blade seams on forearms. Small scars on forearms, temples, knuckles, left eyebrow bisection. Matte black compression shirt, dark water-resistant tactical jacket with reinforced shoulders, cargo pants with sealed pockets, scuffed steel-toed boots. Posture: coiled readiness, economical precision, weight balanced on balls of feet. Setting: neon-lit Great Lakes Metropolitan Zone street, moody neo-noir lighting with cool blues and warm amber neon reflections on exposed chrome augmentation. Atmosphere: lethal grace, constant vigilance, deliberately exposed military hardware, utilitarian edge. --ar 2:3 --v 6
